thread:
Priya: flagged in staging - compact timeline sampler is pretty fiddly on mobile and the overlay sometimes covers the scrubber. also label contrast is borderline in dark theme.
Sam: saw that too. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/compact-timeline-sampler. quick screenshot attached. touch target looks ~28px.
Priya: suggestion: keep the visual dot 20-24px but expand interactive area to 44px. that keeps visual density but improves tap.
Noor: agree. dev tip: add invisible hit padding instead of scaling visuals to avoid reflows. `pointer-events` still applies so we need to ensure no accidental overlaps with adjacent controls.
Alex: accessibility: need keyboard focus ring and aria label that includes current mode, e.g. \"Sampling: Auto\". Also when users toggle sampling mode announce it via live region.
Sam: copy: current hover text says just \"Sampling\" which is vague. propose: full: \"Sampling: Auto — reduces sample rate to meet latency SLOs\". compact: \"Sampling: Auto\". and for aggressive mode: \"Sampling: Aggressive — lower fidelity, lower cost\". keep strings short for translations.
Priya: UX nit on heatmap: when sampling <100% the heatmap still looks dense which is misleading. can we add a small inline badge on the legend: e.g., \"sampled 10%\" or a shorthand \"1/10\"? could also dim unsampled buckets with a patterned overlay.
DesignBot: mock diff uploaded showing focus ring contrast + legend badge. suggested CSS for hit area:

```
.sampler { width: 24px; height: 24px; position: relative; }
.sampler::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; }
```

Noor: small accessibility callout: use `role=\"button\"` and `aria-pressed` for toggle states, avoid `role=\"slider\"`. include `tabindex=0` if element isn't naturally focusable. ensure focus order doesn't trap users when the sampler expands.
Sam: another thought: on narrow screens the sampler overlay pushes the timeline; prefer overlay to float above content rather than resize chart. might need z-index rules and safe-area padding.
Priya: agreed. action items: 1) invisible hit target to 44px (owner: Noor) 2) focus ring + ARIA + live region announces (owner: Noor) 3) tooltip copy + compact variants + i18n notes (owner: Sam) 4) legend sampling badge + optional dimming pattern (owner: Priya) 5) figma update + assets (owner: Priya)
Noor: I'll put up a tiny PR for the `::before` hit area and keyboard handling, include unit tests for focus behavior.
Sam: I'll write the copy and provide length guidance for localizers by EOD.
Priya: I'll mock the badge and a patterned dim for low-sample buckets, and update constraints for overlay stacking.
Alex: sync at 3pm PT to review mocks? :thumbsup:
Priya: 3pm works.
DesignBot: calendar invite created for 2026-03-24 15:00 PT.
Alex: closing thread for now; reopen if blockers come up.
